title: Stock-Rotation Allowance and Authorized Quantity Calculation
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — how the quantity of a stock-rotation return is worked out.**

### A. The line and the requested quantity

A stock-rotation return lets the customer send back unopened stocked merchandise of a returnable item class that has stopped moving, against a yearly rotation allowance; it takes up the ship-to's most recent declined return line whose decline reason is outside the return window, the most recent being the one with the latest date, and the order line, the item and the quantity requested on that declined line are the line, the item and the requested quantity of the rotation return; a ship-to with no such declined line, or with more than one such declined line on that latest date, has no rotation return under this rule, its requested quantity counting as 0.

### B. Lines covered

A stock-rotation return covers only a line that shipped in exactly one shipped-order-line shipment and has no backorder fill line, whose item is stocked and has an item class outside the non-returnable item classes of the ship-to's level (shown in the returns schedule), and whose goods the customer states are unopened; for any other line the returnable quantity counts as 0.

### C. Quantities

1. The quantity authorized is the smallest of the requested quantity, the returnable quantity and the allowance units.
2. The returnable quantity is the quantity of the line's shipped order lines less the quantity of its RMA authorization lines, adding back the quantity of its RMA lines closed without credit, and never below 0.
3. The rotation purchase base is the extended amount of all of the ship-to's shipped order lines and backorder fill lines dated within the 12 months before the request date, a line being within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the request date.
4. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.
5. The gross allowance is 5 percent of the rotation purchase base.
6. Customer-reason return credits already taken, the credit amount of the ship-to's received return lines with return reason ordered in error or no longer needed dated within the 12 months before the request date, are deducted from the gross allowance, never below 0.00, and what remains is capped at 1500.00 to give the allowance, rounded half up to the cent.
7. The allowance units are the allowance divided by the line's invoiced unit price, rounded down to a whole unit; a line with no invoiced unit price above 0.00 has no allowance units.
8. Adjustments to the rotation purchase base are made before any percentage is applied, an adjustment that narrows the merchandise the base counts being made first and an addition to the base being made after it, on the narrowed figure; every percentage that sets the gross allowance multiplies the adjusted purchase base, all of them in one product that is the gross allowance; credits already taken are then deducted from that product, and the cap is applied last, before the division into units.

### D. Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A covered line, invoiced at 11.00 a unit, shipped 100 units in its one shipment; earlier RMAs authorized 40 units, of which 10 closed without credit. The declined line requested 90 units. The ship-to's shipped and filled merchandise of the 12 months is 18000.00 and its customer-reason return credits of the 12 months are 120.00.

| Figure | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Gross allowance | 5 percent of 18000.00 | 900.00 |
| After credits taken | 900.00 less 120.00 | 780.00 |
| Allowance | capped at 1500.00 (not reached), rounded to the cent | 780.00 |
| Allowance units | 780.00 divided by 11.00 is about 70.91, rounded down | 70 |
| Returnable quantity | 100 less 40 plus 10 | 70 |
| Quantity authorized | smallest of 90, 70 and 70 | 70 |

Had the credits taken been 950.00, the amount after credits would be 0.00, the allowance 0.00 and the quantity authorized 0. Had two qualifying declined lines carried the same latest date, the requested quantity would count as 0.
